description: This Kotlin source file defines the DocumentsFragment class, which presents a list of scanned documents with functionalities such as search, selection, merging, and exporting to PDF within an Android application.

classes.name: DocumentsFragment
classes.description: A Fragment that displays a list of scanned documents with search, export, and merge functionalities.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DocumentsFragment.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Sets up menu options when the fragment is attached to its context.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment's layout and initializes RecyclerView and SearchView.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Configures RecyclerView layout and adapter, and sets up search query listeners.

methods.name: addMenu
methods.description: Adds menu options for exporting and merging PDFs via MenuProvider.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads documents from repository matching the search query and updates the adapter.

methods.name: exportSelected
methods.description: Exports selected documents as a PDF in a background coroutine.

methods.name: mergeSelected
methods.description: Merges selected documents into a single PDF in a background coroutine.

methods.name: onDestroyView
methods.description: Clears references to views when the fragment's view is destroyed.
